stem: An allosteric inhibitor typically binds where on the enzyme?

options.label: A
options.text: Only to ribosomal RNA in the cytosol

options.label: B
options.text: At a regulatory site away from catalysis
options.misconception: None; allosteric ligands bind elsewhere and reshape function.
options.explanation: OpenStax describes an allosteric site that still prevents substrate binding at the active site.

options.label: C
options.text: First destroys the substrate in solution
options.misconception: Not required for classic allosteric control.
options.explanation: Classic allostery is conformational on the enzyme.

options.label: D
options.text: Covalently on the catalytic nucleophile only
options.explanation: Allosteric sites are separate regulatory pockets.

options.label: E
options.text: Only to oxygen within complex IV

context: Learning objective: allosteric inhibitors bind away from the active site.
